second pointer start cancels first stroke without taking ownership or committing partial protection
face, mode, sliders, detection, selection, release and manual switches cancel an unfinished stroke
stale revision, canvas replacement, in-place resize, face geometry and draft replacement cannot commit old pointer
mask undo redo never changes beauty controls or other person parameters
parameter reset preserves protection; no-effect mask-only operation cannot Apply
clear and feather are undoable mask edits; selected face clearing preserves neighbor protection
zero strength commits no stroke or undo record and invalid brush values do not alter pixels
redetection is staged; acceptance clears all masks/history and reversed new numbering never inherits settings
mask-only edits still need redetection confirmation; stale confirmation cannot replace later edits
